description: This file defines the Category model class for the OpenCart admin module, containing methods for managing category data including add, edit, delete, retrieve, and hierarchical path operations in the database.

classes.name: Category
classes.description: A model class for handling CRUD operations, hierarchy management, and related data of categories in the OpenCart admin system.

methods.name: addCategory
methods.description: Creates a new category record in the database, including descriptions, hierarchy, filters, stores, SEO URLs, and layout info.

methods.name: editCategory
methods.description: Updates an existing category record and all associated data, paths, SEO URLs, filters, stores, and layouts.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status (active/inactive) of a specific category.

methods.name: deleteCategory
methods.description: Removes a category and all its associated data, including related products, coupons, SEO URLs, paths, filters, stores, layouts, and cache.

methods.name: repairCategories
methods.description: Repairs the category hierarchy paths for a given parent category, fixing any inconsistencies.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Retrieves detailed data for a specific category, including its hierarchical path as a string.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Retrieves a list of categories based on filters like store, name, parent, status, with sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalCategories
methods.description: Returns the total count of categories matching optional filters.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds or updates a category description for a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions associated with a category.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all category descriptions for a specific language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Fetches all descriptions associated with a category.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Fetches all descriptions for a specific language.

methods.name: addPath
methods.description: Adds a hierarchical path record for a category.

methods.name: deletePaths
methods.description: Removes all path records for a category.

methods.name: deletePathsByLevel
methods.description: Deletes path records for a category below a specific level.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the concatenated string of path IDs for a category.

methods.name: getPaths
methods.description: Retrieves all path records for a category, ordered by level.

methods.name: getPathsByPathId
methods.description: Fetches all path records matching a specific path ID.

methods.name: addFilter
methods.description: Associates a filter with a category.

methods.name: deleteFilters
methods.description: Removes all filters associated with a category.

methods.name: deleteFiltersByFilterId
methods.description: Deletes filter associations based on filter ID.

methods.name: getFilters
methods.description: Gets all filter IDs associated with a category.

methods.name: addStore
methods.description: Associates a category with a store.

methods.name: deleteStores
methods.description: Removes store associations for a category.

methods.name: deleteStoresByStoreId
methods.description: Deletes all category-store associations for a specific store.

methods.name: getStores
methods.description: Retrieves store IDs associated with a category.

methods.name: addLayout
methods.description: Associates a layout with a category and store.

methods.name: deleteLayouts
methods.description: Removes all layout associations for a category.

methods.name: deleteLayoutsByLayoutId
methods.description: Deletes all category layout associations for a specific layout.

methods.name: deleteLayoutsByStoreId
methods.description: Deletes all category layout associations for a specific store.

methods.name: getLayouts
methods.description: Retrieves layout IDs associated with a category per store.

methods.name: getTotalLayoutsByLayoutId
methods.description: Returns the count of categories associated with a specific layout.
